# Finding out why my trees all have low support

Low support in gene trees is usually a symptom of something else. There is either 
1) too little phylogenetic signal per gene, 
2) missing/gappy data, 
3) alignment problems, 
4) genuine conflict among sites. We can investigat this using CAPTUS output stats from the alignment step.

Low support
    │
    ├── Little signal
    │      └── few informative sites
    │
    ├── Poor data
    │      ├── missing data
    │      ├── short sequences
    │      └── alignment problems
    │
    ├── Model/data issues
    │
    └── Genuine conflicting signal
           ├── ILS
           ├── introgression
           └── other biological processes


The most informative plot will probably be 02_PI_sites_vs_UFBoot.pdf. If support rises strongly with the number of parsimony-informative sites, that would suggest that much of your low gene-tree support is caused by limited phylogenetic information within individual loci.

One caveat: mean UFBoot is a convenient diagnostic summary, but it isn't itself a formal measure of “gene quality.” I would use it to investigate patterns rather than immediately remove genes with low means.

Once you run this, you can paste the first ~10 lines of gene_tree_QC.csv and the support_correlations.csv results here, and I can help you interpret what is driving the low support in your Captus gene trees and what that implies for collapsing branches before ASTRAL.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# per-gene stats
aln_stats <- 
  read.csv("data/04_alignments/captus-align_alignments.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE, skip = 2) %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  group_by(trimmed, paralog_filter, with_refs, marker_type, format, locus)


support_stats <- 
  read.csv("data/05_phylogeny/nuc_gene_trees/gene_support_summary.csv")
```


```{r}
glimpse(support_stats)
glimpse(aln_stats)
```

# ============================================================
# Captus gene-tree QC
#
# Matches:
#   4471.faa  <-> 4471.treefile
#
# Calculates:
#   - number of taxa
#   - alignment length
#   - missing/gap percentage
#   - variable sites
#   - parsimony-informative sites
#   - number of supported internal branches
#   - mean/median UFBoot
#   - percentage UFBoot < 50
#   - percentage UFBoot < 70
#   - percentage UFBoot >= 95
#
# Produces:
#   gene_tree_QC.csv
#   several diagnostic plots
# ============================================================


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Packages
# ------------------------------------------------------------
install.packages(c(
  "ape",
  "ggplot2",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "purrr",
  "stringr"
))


library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. SET YOUR PATHS HERE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

PROJ <- "~/CAPTUS_pipeline_2026"

# Change this if your .faa files are somewhere else
ALIGN_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJ,
  "data/04_alignments/03_trimmed/06_informed/01_coding_NUC/02_NT"
)

# Directory containing your IQ-TREE gene trees
TREE_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJ,
  "data/05_phylogeny/nuc_gene_trees"
)

# Where QC results will be saved
OUT_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJ,
  "data/05_phylogeny/gene_tree_QC"
)

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Find alignment and tree files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alignment_files <- list.files(
  ALIGN_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.fna$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

tree_files <- list.files(
  TREE_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.treefile$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Found", length(alignment_files), "FNA alignments\n")
cat("Found", length(tree_files), "IQ-TREE gene trees\n")
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Function to calculate alignment statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_alignment_stats <- function(file) {

  gene <- basename(file) |>
    str_remove("\\.fna$")

  # Read protein FASTA
  aln <- read.FASTA(file, type = "DNA")

  # Convert alignment to character matrix
seq_list <- as.character(aln)

mat <- do.call(rbind, seq_list)

  n_taxa <- nrow(mat)
  aln_length <- ncol(mat)

  # Missing characters:
  # gap (-), unknown (?), X, N
  missing_chars <- c("-", "?", "X", "x", "N", "n")

  missing_count <- sum(mat %in% missing_chars)

  pct_missing <- 100 * missing_count / length(mat)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Variable and parsimony-informative sites
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  variable_sites <- 0
  pi_sites <- 0

  for (i in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {

    site <- mat[, i]

    # Remove gaps / missing states
    site <- site[!site %in% missing_chars]

    if (length(site) == 0) {
      next
    }

    counts <- table(site)

    # Variable site = more than one observed amino acid
    if (length(counts) > 1) {
      variable_sites <- variable_sites + 1
    }

    # Parsimony informative:
    # at least two states represented >= 2 times
    if (sum(counts >= 2) >= 2) {
      pi_sites <- pi_sites + 1
    }
  }

    tibble(
    gene = gene,
    n_taxa = n_taxa,
    alignment_length = aln_length,
    pct_missing = pct_missing,
    variable_sites = variable_sites,
    pi_sites = pi_sites,
    pct_variable = 100 * variable_sites / aln_length,
    pct_pi = 100 * pi_sites / aln_length
  )
}
```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Calculate statistics for all alignments
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nReading alignments...\n")

alignment_stats <- map_dfr(
  alignment_files,
  get_alignment_stats
)

cat("Finished alignment statistics.\n")

```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Function to extract IQ-TREE support values
#
# Your tree labels look like:
#
#     42.1/59
#
# where:
#     42.1 = SH-aLRT
#     59   = UFBoot
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_tree_stats <- function(file) {

  gene <- basename(file) |>
    str_remove("\\.treefile$")

  tree <- read.tree(file)

  labels <- tree$node.label

  if (is.null(labels)) {

    return(
      tibble(
        gene = gene,
        n_supported_branches = 0,
        mean_alrt = NA_real_,
        median_alrt = NA_real_,
        mean_ufboot = NA_real_,
        median_ufboot = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_lt50 = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_lt70 = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_ge95 = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  # Keep labels containing "/"
  labels <- labels[str_detect(labels, "/")]

  if (length(labels) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        gene = gene,
        n_supported_branches = 0,
        mean_alrt = NA_real_,
        median_alrt = NA_real_,
        mean_ufboot = NA_real_,
        median_ufboot = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_lt50 = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_lt70 = NA_real_,
        pct_ufboot_ge95 = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  # Split SH-aLRT/UFBoot
  support <- str_split_fixed(labels, "/", 2)

  alrt <- as.numeric(support[, 1])
  ufboot <- as.numeric(support[, 2])


  tibble(
    gene = gene,

    n_supported_branches = length(ufboot),

    mean_alrt = mean(alrt, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_alrt = median(alrt, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_ufboot = mean(ufboot, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ufboot = median(ufboot, na.rm = TRUE),

    pct_ufboot_lt50 =
      100 * mean(ufboot < 50, na.rm = TRUE),

    pct_ufboot_lt70 =
      100 * mean(ufboot < 70, na.rm = TRUE),

    pct_ufboot_ge95 =
      100 * mean(ufboot >= 95, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Calculate tree statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nReading gene trees...\n")

tree_stats <- map_dfr(
  tree_files,
  get_tree_stats
)

cat("Finished tree statistics.\n")
```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine alignment + tree statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qc <- full_join(
  alignment_stats,
  tree_stats,
  by = "gene"
)


# Sort by mean UFBoot
qc <- qc |>
  arrange(mean_ufboot)

```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine alignment + tree statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qc <- full_join(
  alignment_stats,
  tree_stats,
  by = "gene"
)


# Sort by mean UFBoot
qc <- qc |>
  arrange(mean_ufboot)

```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Print summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DATASET SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n\n")

print(
  qc |>
    summarise(
      genes = n(),
      median_taxa = median(n_taxa, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_length = median(alignment_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_missing = median(pct_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_PI_sites = median(pi_sites, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_UFBoot = median(mean_ufboot, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)


```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Informative sites vs UFBoot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p2 <- ggplot(
  qc,
  aes(x = pi_sites, y = mean_ufboot)
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    color = "#2C7FB8"
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    x = "Parsimony-informative sites",
    y = "Mean UFBoot",
    title = "Phylogenetic information vs gene-tree support"
  )


ggsave(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "02_PI_sites_vs_UFBoot.pdf"),
  p2,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

correlations <- tibble(

  variable = c(
    "alignment_length",
    "n_taxa",
    "pct_missing",
    "variable_sites",
    "pi_sites"
  ),

  correlation_with_mean_UFBoot = c(

    cor(
      qc$alignment_length,
      qc$mean_ufboot,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    ),

    cor(
      qc$n_taxa,
      qc$mean_ufboot,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    ),

    cor(
      qc$pct_missing,
      qc$mean_ufboot,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    ),

    cor(
      qc$variable_sites,
      qc$mean_ufboot,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    ),

    cor(
      qc$pi_sites,
      qc$mean_ufboot,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    )
  )
)

write.csv(
  correlations,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "support_correlations.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nCorrelations with mean UFBoot:\n")
print(correlations)

cat("\nDone!\n")
```
